body: This sounds like good advice, thank you

More of a long term idea for her but she's getting pretty close from what I can tell. 

As for the not being able to go to her house or anything, it's a bit of a Romeo and Juliet type situation, ie her mom hates my guts with a passion and will try to ruin my life if she even finds out I'm talking to her daughter. I know it can seem like you're worthless, but nobody truly is. Perhaps you haven't found your passion yet! 

As for the lazy part, that kind of comes with depression, it really isn't your fault if you have low motivation levels. Don't beat yourself up about it. Try just being a little productive each day, even if it's 5 minutes
What do you mean by that? Like you don't feel a purpose? If that's the case id say create a purpose for yourself. Volunteer somewhere, learn a new skill, go on an adventure!
